hack.root_cause: DNS hijack of curve.fi → malicious contract injection → approval harvesting drain
hack.description: Curve Finance's $5.7B in smart contracts survived untouched, but a DNS hijack of curve.fi redirected users to a clone that stole $575K in approvals — a reminder that DeFi still runs on web2 infrastructure.
